confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Busan price levels, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are firmest; hostel and hotel anchors are wide July beach-season estimates that vary by district and date. Cocktail and wine_glass are inferred from typical markups over the draft beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value taken from search summaries of rba.gov.au pages, not from opening them directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Busan is not among the supplied comparables, so it was placed within the East Asian set (Taipei, Beijing, Kyoto): beer and cafe prices modestly above Taipei, inexpensive meals above Taipei and Beijing but below Kyoto, and accommodation above Taipei for July peak demand but well below Kyoto's three-star rate.
